document_title: Adobe Express Integrated with ChatGPT - 10 Persona Test Dataset

creative_task.description: Use ChatGPT with Adobe Express to create a professional creative asset featuring an eagle image on a yellow background.
creative_task.common_success_result: A completed Adobe Express design with an eagle as the primary visual, a yellow background, persona-appropriate layout decisions, and export-ready quality.

adobe_express_capability_catalog.purpose: Create or modify Adobe Express designs through natural-language instructions from ChatGPT.
Apply AI-assisted edits such as background adjustment, object placement, cleanup, and style refinement.
Generate or refine visual assets when a suitable source image is not provided.
Apply approved fonts, colors, logos, brand kits, and locked templates.
Protect enterprise data, avoid sensitive content exposure, and maintain policy-compliant workflows.
Adapt the final design to multiple channels such as social posts, slides, flyers, and banners.
Share drafts, request feedback, and document review comments inside the design workflow.
Assess readability, contrast, alt text, and accessible layout quality.
Perform fast design operations such as background removal, crop, format conversion, and export.
Start from professionally designed Adobe Express templates that fit the persona's channel and use case.

personas.name: Maya Srinivasan
personas.ai_trust_level: Medium-high; trusts AI drafts after brand and compliance review
personas.accessibility_needs: Requires readable contrast and mobile-safe text sizing
personas.privacy_posture: Do not upload confidential campaign plans, customer lists, or unreleased brand assets unless approved
acceptance_criteria: Eagle is the central visual element
Yellow background uses an approved brand shade
Design follows enterprise brand kit
Copy is concise and campaign-ready
Final asset is ready for review and export

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Maya prioritizes brand consistency and needs the yellow background, fonts, and logo placement to match approved enterprise standards.
Her prompt style is structured, so she can efficiently direct ChatGPT to create the design in Adobe Express with clear campaign constraints.
Her workflow requires stakeholder review before publishing.
Marketing assets often need variations for LinkedIn, email headers, and internal slides.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use a warm enterprise-approved yellow, such as #FFD447, with dark navy or charcoal text for readability.
prompt_points: Open an Adobe Express brand-approved template
Add or generate an eagle image as the hero visual
Set the background to approved yellow
Apply brand fonts and logo rules
personas.isolated_test_prompt: You are assisting an enterprise marketing manager. In Adobe Express, use Conversational Design Creation to build a campaign-ready design with an eagle as the main subject on a yellow background. Apply Enterprise Brand Control so the yellow, fonts, and logo placement follow the brand kit. Use AI-Powered Editing only to improve the eagle placement, clean edges, and balance the composition. Add a short confident headline, keep all copy brand-safe, and avoid unapproved claims. Use Collaboration and Comments to mark the draft for stakeholder review, then use Resize and Repurpose to prepare LinkedIn post and presentation-slide versions.

personas.name: Jordan Lee
personas.ai_trust_level: Medium; accepts AI suggestions only after measurable accessibility checks
personas.accessibility_needs: Screen-reader compatibility, high contrast, keyboard-friendly review flow, meaningful alt text
personas.privacy_posture: Avoid personal data in prompts and do not expose internal audit findings
acceptance_criteria: Contrast is checked for all text on yellow background
Eagle image has concise alt text
Design has clear reading order
No information is communicated by color alone
Accessibility notes are included for review

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Jordan's core behavior is validation against accessibility requirements, so contrast, alt text, and reading order must be explicitly checked.
AI edits can improve visual clarity, but Jordan requires measurable quality checks afterward.
Jordan uses direct checklist prompts to instruct ChatGPT and Adobe Express without ambiguity.
Accessibility findings need to be documented for designers and product stakeholders.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use #F7C948 or similar yellow with #111111 text, avoiding pale yellow behind white text.
personas.isolated_test_prompt: Act as an accessibility QA analyst testing Adobe Express with ChatGPT. Use Conversational Design Creation to make a simple design featuring one eagle image on a yellow background. Use AI-Powered Editing to keep the eagle edges clean and reduce visual clutter. Run Accessibility Checks for contrast, reading order, and alt text; use dark text on the yellow background and do not rely on color alone to communicate meaning. Add the alt text: 'Eagle centered on a bright yellow background.' Use Collaboration and Comments to record any accessibility concerns before export.

personas.name: Elena Martinez
personas.ai_trust_level: Low; requires conservative outputs and reviewable reasoning
personas.accessibility_needs: Clear text hierarchy and readable compliance notes
personas.privacy_posture: No confidential documents, regulated data, personal data, or third-party copyrighted assets in prompts
avoid_list: copyrighted eagle images without usage rights
acceptance_criteria: Uses licensed or generated eagle imagery
No confidential or regulated data appears in the design
Design includes review placeholder instead of legal claims
Compliance review step is visible
Asset is not marked final until approved

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Elena's low AI trust and legal role require strong controls around source assets, sensitive data, and review status.
Generating a new eagle image reduces dependency on questionable third-party copyrighted material.
Approved templates and brand settings reduce compliance risk in enterprise communications.
Legal review needs documented comments and sign-off before the design is treated as final.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use a muted corporate yellow, such as #F2C94C, with conservative spacing and no urgent visual language.
prompt_points: Use generated or licensed eagle image only
Flag asset as compliance review required
personas.isolated_test_prompt: Support a legal and compliance officer using Adobe Express with ChatGPT. Create a draft-only design with a generated or properly licensed eagle image on a muted yellow background. Use Generate Image if no approved eagle asset is available. Apply Enterprise Brand Control for approved colors and fonts, and use Security & Compliance rules: do not include confidential data, personal data, legal promises, or third-party copyrighted content. Add a small footer note that says 'Draft for compliance review.' Use Collaboration and Comments to request legal approval before export.

personas.name: Tyler Brooks
personas.privacy_posture: Avoid sharing account credentials, unreleased sponsor details, or private audience data
acceptance_criteria: Bold eagle visual catches attention on mobile
Yellow background feels vibrant
Text is short and readable
Design is exportable for Instagram and TikTok
At least two visual variations are produced

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Tyler moves quickly and benefits from starting with a modern social template.
He trusts AI for quick visual refinements and attention-grabbing edits.
The same creative needs to work across Instagram posts, stories, and TikTok covers.
Fast background cleanup, crop, and export operations match his speed-focused workflow.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use a vivid yellow, such as #FFD400, with oversized black or deep purple text for mobile impact.
personas.isolated_test_prompt: Help a social media creator make a bold Adobe Express asset fast. Start from the Template Library with a social post layout, then place a dramatic eagle image on a vivid yellow background. Use AI-Powered Editing to sharpen the eagle, add energy, and make the composition pop without crowding the design. Keep the text short, mobile-readable, and informal. Use Quick Actions for crop and cleanup, then Resize and Repurpose the result for Instagram square, Instagram story, and TikTok cover formats.

personas.name: Priya Nair
personas.ai_trust_level: Medium; wants AI help but needs clear explanations
personas.accessibility_needs: Readable text for classroom projection and printed handouts
personas.privacy_posture: Do not include student names, grades, school IDs, or private classroom information
acceptance_criteria: Teacher can follow each step
Eagle visual is classroom-appropriate
Yellow background is bright but not distracting
Text can be read from the back of a classroom
Design can be printed or shown on a slide

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Priya needs simple natural-language steps that guide her through the design process.
A classroom-friendly template reduces design complexity for a less technical user.
Projected classroom materials need strong readability and contrast.
The same design may be used as a slide and as a printable handout.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use a soft classroom-friendly yellow, such as #FFE680, with large dark text.
personas.isolated_test_prompt: Guide me like a teacher who is new to Adobe Express. Use Conversational Design Creation to make a classroom-safe design with a friendly eagle image on a soft yellow background. Start with a simple education template from the Template Library. Give me clear steps: add the image, check the background color, add a large title, and verify readability. Run Accessibility Checks so the text can be seen on a projector. Do not include student names or private school information. Resize and Repurpose the final design as one slide and one printable handout.

personas.name: Ahmed Khan
personas.ai_trust_level: Medium-high; uses AI for drafts but checks cultural fit
personas.accessibility_needs: Inclusive language, high readability, clear layout for multilingual audiences
personas.privacy_posture: Avoid employee personal data, internal HR cases, and confidential workforce information
acceptance_criteria: Message is inclusive and globally understandable
Eagle image is symbolic but not nationalistic
Yellow background is optimistic and readable
Design supports translation or localization
No employee data appears in the asset

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Ahmed needs global HR messages to remain aligned with corporate brand standards.
He can specify inclusive language and audience constraints directly through ChatGPT.
Global communications need readable layouts for diverse users and possible translation.
HR content is commonly distributed through email banners, intranet posts, and slides.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use a welcoming golden yellow, such as #F9D65C, paired with dark neutral text and generous whitespace.
personas.isolated_test_prompt: Create an Adobe Express design for a global HR communication. Use Conversational Design Creation to place a calm, symbolic eagle image on a golden yellow background. Apply Enterprise Brand Control for approved colors and fonts. Keep the message inclusive, short, and easy to translate; avoid culture-specific idioms and do not include employee personal data. Use Accessibility Checks to confirm readable contrast and spacing. Use Resize and Repurpose to create an intranet banner, email header, and presentation slide version.

personas.name: Grace Williams
personas.ai_trust_level: Medium; welcomes AI ideas if they remain authentic
personas.accessibility_needs: Readable public-facing materials and clear call to action
personas.privacy_posture: Do not include donor records, beneficiary identities, or private volunteer information
acceptance_criteria: Eagle communicates hope or resilience
Yellow background feels optimistic
Call to action is clear
Design can be reused for flyer and social post
No private donor or beneficiary data is present

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Grace needs professional results without heavy design effort or extra cost.
AI can polish the eagle image and layout while keeping the workflow efficient.
Nonprofit outreach often reuses one asset across flyers, social posts, and newsletters.
Her privacy posture requires keeping donor and beneficiary information out of AI prompts and designs.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use an optimistic yellow, such as #FFDD66, with simple dark text and a clear call-to-action block.
personas.isolated_test_prompt: Help a nonprofit outreach coordinator create a hopeful Adobe Express design. Start from the Template Library with a clean flyer or social layout, add an eagle image that suggests resilience, and set the background to optimistic yellow. Use AI-Powered Editing to polish the image and keep the design uncluttered. Add one sincere call to action without using manipulative wording. Follow Security & Compliance by excluding donor records, beneficiary names, and private volunteer details. Use Resize and Repurpose for a printable flyer and a square social post.

personas.name: Naomi Chen
personas.ai_trust_level: Medium; values speed but checks executive tone
personas.accessibility_needs: Large readable text for meeting screens
personas.privacy_posture: Do not reveal executive schedules, attendee lists, confidential strategy, or meeting materials
acceptance_criteria: Design looks polished for executive viewing
Eagle image is refined, not aggressive
Yellow background is elegant and controlled
No confidential meeting information is included
Output is ready for presentation use

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Naomi needs to issue concise instructions and receive a polished result quickly.
Executive materials must look official and follow approved brand standards.
Deadline pressure makes fast crop, cleanup, and export operations important.
She handles confidential executive information and must avoid exposing it in prompts or designs.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use a restrained premium yellow, such as #EAC54F, with minimal copy and strong margins.
personas.isolated_test_prompt: Create a polished executive-ready Adobe Express design. Use Conversational Design Creation to place a refined eagle image on a restrained yellow background with minimal copy. Apply Enterprise Brand Control for approved fonts, spacing, and colors. Use Quick Actions to crop and clean the eagle image quickly. Follow Security & Compliance: do not include executive schedules, attendee names, confidential strategy, or meeting details. Export a presentation-ready version with large readable text.

personas.name: Leo Park
personas.ai_trust_level: High for ideation; manually reviews final aesthetic choices
personas.accessibility_needs: Maintains visual hierarchy and legible typography despite artistic styling
personas.privacy_posture: Do not upload client-confidential sketches, paid references, or unreleased artwork
acceptance_criteria: Eagle has a distinctive art direction
Yellow background supports the illustration style
Design does not imitate a specific living artist
Typography remains legible
At least three style variations are generated

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Leo wants distinctive visual exploration and can use generation for new eagle concepts.
He can refine composition, color, and image treatment while preserving artistic intent.
His detailed prompt style maps well to iterative creative direction through ChatGPT.
Templates provide layout scaffolding while he customizes the illustration style.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use layered yellow tones, such as #F6C945 and #FFE27A, to add depth without reducing text legibility.
personas.isolated_test_prompt: Work with me as a freelance illustrator testing Adobe Express and ChatGPT. Use Generate Image to create three original eagle concepts on a layered yellow background: clean vector, textured poster, and minimal geometric. Do not imitate any specific living artist or use client-confidential references. Use Conversational Design Creation to compare the three options, then use AI-Powered Editing to refine the strongest design for balance, contrast, and legible typography. If a template helps, use the Template Library only as layout scaffolding, not as the final style.

personas.name: Marcus Brown
personas.ai_trust_level: Low-medium; tests AI workflows for data handling and policy boundaries
personas.accessibility_needs: Clear audit notes and readable technical labels
personas.privacy_posture: No credentials, API keys, tenant identifiers, internal URLs, logs, or security incident details in prompts
acceptance_criteria: Workflow avoids secrets and internal identifiers
Security and compliance controls are referenced
Eagle-on-yellow design is created without sensitive inputs
Export process is documented
No policy bypass is suggested

mapped_adobe_express_features.behavior_driven_reason: Marcus is specifically testing whether the integration respects enterprise data handling and policy boundaries.
He needs reproducible prompts to verify how ChatGPT instructs Adobe Express.
Brand-controlled assets reduce the need to upload uncontrolled files during security testing.
Quick Actions allow controlled edits without exposing unnecessary data or complex asset flows.

personas.yellow_background_recommendation: Use a standard approved yellow, such as #FFD23F, and avoid embedding hidden metadata or sensitive labels.
prompt_points: Create design with no sensitive inputs
personas.isolated_test_prompt: Run this as an IT security administrator validating Adobe Express integration with ChatGPT. Use Conversational Design Creation to create an eagle-on-yellow-background design using only approved non-sensitive assets. Apply Enterprise Brand Control and Security & Compliance settings. Do not include credentials, API keys, tenant IDs, internal URLs, logs, incident details, or any policy bypass instructions. Use Quick Actions only for crop, cleanup, and export. Add a small non-confidential note in the design comments: 'Security test asset - no sensitive data used.'
